entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yes, we've found it! This is it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But we haven't found any information[n]about the mental collapses. That bothers[n]me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We got this far. Wouldn't it be better to[n]just squeeze the truth outta the guy?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That plan is fine by me.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's send out the calling card and take[n]his Treasure then.

entries.en: You can decide when we do so.
